reviewed_sources.title: Supergravity spectrum on AdS2 x S2
reviewed_sources.read_scope: Title and introduction, Sections 2.1-2.2 for bosonic normalization, complete bosonic Section 3: gauge fixing and residual gauges (3.1-3.3), linearized Einstein-Maxwell equations (3.4), two-dimensional tensor constraint (3.5), exceptional l=0 and l=1 modes (3.6-3.7), general l>=2 sector (3.8), summary (3.9). reviewed_sources.use: Scalar and vector mass matrices have eigenvalues l(l-1) and (l+1)(l+2); the physical l=1 scalar has mass squared six. The boundary modes and residual gauge discussion prevent use of the positive bulk spectrum alone as a global mouth-matching inverse.
reviewed_sources.independent_checks: Algebraic characteristic polynomials of both displayed mass matrices; symmetric similarity of the scalar matrix; direct elimination of the l=1 scalar equations. This is not an independent derivation of every four-dimensional mode equation.
reviewed_sources.limits: Fermionic Section 4, representation analysis in Section 5 and supersymmetry dependencies are not reviewed or imported. In particular, the extra l=1 scalar boundary mode is left unconstrained by the reviewed bulk equation; its mass argument from Section 5 is not adopted. Boundary gauge freedom depends on boundary conditions, which differ in the physical two-mouth problem. No supersymmetry is assigned to the QED model.
